appearance.extreme: Their ears are enormous, veined and mobile, swivelling independently. They wince when the door goes.
appearance.obvious: Their ears are broad and thin enough to light through, and they turn slightly toward every sound in the room.
appearance.subtle: Their ears are larger than they ought to be, and set oddly high.

description: Your ears have grown and thinned out, and they turn toward sound on their own. You hear everything now, whether or not you wanted to.
name: Enlarged Ears
